meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, Handbook of Statistics on Indian States (via DBIE)
meta.coverage: State-wise Capital Expenditure: RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian States, Table 173
meta.note: DBIE report 1714, data provider "Main". Values exactly as DBIE serves them (rupee amounts are served in rupees). Periods: fiscal years, dated at April. Dimensions: none; measures: actual, budget estimate, revised estimate. Andhra Pradesh before 2014-15 is the undivided state, a separate series (Telangana was formed on 2 June 2014; 2014-15 straddles the split). Jammu & Kashmir to 2018-19 (with Ladakh) and from 2019-20 (the UT) are separate series; 2019-20 straddles the change of 31 October 2019.
